description: This is a test specification file for the Playwright framework, testing 'beforeunload' event handling and related navigation and dialog behaviors.

methods.name: should close browser with beforeunload page
methods.description: Tests closing the browser when the page with 'beforeunload' handlers is open.

methods.name: should close browsercontext with beforeunload page
methods.description: Tests closing a browser context with a page having 'beforeunload' handlers.

methods.name: should be able to navigate away from page with beforeunload
methods.description: Verifies navigation away from a page that has 'beforeunload' handlers.

methods.name: should close page with beforeunload listener
methods.description: Tests closing a page that has a 'beforeunload' listener.

methods.name: should run beforeunload if asked for @smoke
methods.description: Tests the dialog that appears when closing a page with 'beforeunload' event, checking dialog types and messages.

methods.name: should access page after beforeunload
methods.description: Verifies that evaluating the page after a 'beforeunload' dialog is dismissed works correctly.

methods.name: should not stall on evaluate when dismissing beforeunload
methods.description: Ensures that evaluating the page after dismissing a 'beforeunload' dialog does not hang.

methods.name: should not stall on click when dismissing beforeunload
methods.description: Ensures that clicking links after dismissing 'beforeunload' dialogs proceeds correctly without hanging.

methods.name: should support dismissing the dialog multiple times
methods.description: Verifies that dismissing dialogs multiple times is handled gracefully.

methods.name: should support closing the page after a previous dismiss
methods.description: Tests closing the page after dismissing a prior 'beforeunload' dialog.

methods.name: should support closing the page via a subsequent onbeforeunload dialog
methods.description: Ensures that accepting the 'beforeunload' dialog leads to page closure properly.
